readme: Written by build.py. The references are (x0, ydot0, T) of the symmetric orbit that leaves the x-axis at a right angle at theta0, in the rotating-pulsating frame. The corrections give the first node (x, y, xdot, ydot) and the targeted arc of each converged run. The members of a continuation run are Y = (x0, ydot0, T/2, C) for the Lyapunov family and Y = (x0, ydot0, e) for family 11 at theta0 = 0 and the period 2 pi.
